H1 followed by H2 creates a nested group under the H1

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<h1>Chapter One</h1><p>Chapter intro.</p><h2>Section One</h2><p>Section content.</p>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(include_document_structure: true))
puts result.content.inspect
puts result.document.nodes.inspect
```
